title: Kitchen and Summer
author: Sable Whitlock
blurb: Gideon Villalobos, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
